cases.prompt: 抽取这张技术路线图的风格，给我可复用提示词。
cases.baseline_output: A prompt that says the reference image supplies visual language and names source-specific content.
with_skill_output: one complete modular prompt pasted in the final response
assertions: delivery mode is prompt-only
the final response does not list internal reports, JSON specs or quality files
the prompt contains all eleven required Chinese modules
style prompt contains every signature anchor prompt token
style prompt contains a reusable content slot
style prompt contains no reference-image role language
style prompt contains no source_exclusions literal
cases.human_notes: Judge whether the user can copy the prompt directly, and whether it remains complete after all conversation context and reference images are removed.

cases.prompt: 提取这张科研示意图真正有辨识度的风格，不要只说科技感、扁平化和马卡龙。
cases.baseline_output: A list of generic aesthetic adjectives.
assertions: five to seven signature anchors cover at least four dimensions
anchor weights sum to 100
each anchor has evidence, transfer rule and prompt token
all eight visual-system dimensions contain observations and transfer rules
anti_generic names concrete template failures and positive alternatives
cases.human_notes: Judge the delivered prompt; internal fingerprint artifacts are evidence, not default user-facing content.

cases.prompt: 提取这张技术图的完整风格提示词，每个模块都要能直接约束生成。
cases.baseline_output: A modular prompt whose palette says only pale yellow and deep blue, while other sections contain generic adjectives.
assertions: layout contains an aspect ratio, reading path, grid, spacing and density
components contain shape, stroke, fill and padding
connectors contain line type, arrow, width, color and routing
icon style contains family, outline, view and detail level
palette provides at least three concrete #RRGGBB values, keeps stable structural roles separate from neutral accent slots, and remaps accent semantics from new content
typography covers main title, module title and body with hierarchy parameters
signature style section contains five to seven numbered features
cases.human_notes: Judge whether every section is operational rather than merely present.

cases.prompt: 把这张空间智能架构图的风格保存成模板，以后也要能画供应链、医学和教育主题。
cases.baseline_output: A reusable prompt that still lists source-topic icons, fixes colors to source business roles, and bans optional media globally.
assertions: layout preserves visual rhythm but explicitly replans zones and reading path from new-content topology
icon section specifies visual treatment and derives concrete subjects from new content without source-topic example lists
palette preserves concrete hex values but uses neutral accent slots whose semantics are reassigned from new-content hierarchy
Logo, photos, 3D, gradients, glow, glass and shadows are defaults or conditional rules rather than universal hard bans
hard constraints are limited to accuracy, topology, non-fabrication, source separation, legibility and clipping safety
same-topic rendered validation leaves portability_status untested
portability_status becomes passed only after a distinct-topic review verifies replanning, subject derivation, color remapping and no source-content carryover
cases.human_notes: Judge portability by swapping to an unrelated topic. The visual grammar should survive while source objects, business semantics and topology do not.

cases.prompt: 参考这张技术路线图的风格，把这段朴素的七阶段研究说明画成图；请先想清楚怎么图示化。
cases.baseline_output: Seven equal columns copied from the paragraph order with long text packed into cards.
assertions: visual plan states audience, communication goal, core narrative and primary takeaway
chosen archetype is justified by new-content relations
at least one near alternative is rejected with a reason
each primary node has a visual role and zone
each required relation has a connector encoding
each signature anchor has a placement or adaptation
compression decisions distinguish verbatim, concise, annotation and omitted content
cases.human_notes: Judge whether the result communicates a designed narrative rather than mechanically converting paragraphs into equal cards.

cases.prompt: 基于参考图风格和我的内容直接出图，只要纯图片。
cases.baseline_output: A renderer decision that may fall back to vector or hybrid output.
assertions: mode is generate and renderer is imagegen
planning_status is complete before generation
generation prompt keeps all eleven modular sections and every style anchor
the reference image is bound through referenced_image_paths or num_last_images_to_include
generation record matches the exact prompt and bound reference image
final raster is saved in the job output directory
the final response includes both the image and the exact complete prompt
the final response does not expose internal planning or validation files
cases.human_notes: Judge style fidelity across layout, components, linework, typography or iconography, not palette alone.

cases.prompt: 借鉴这张图的风格，但替换成我的内容，不要原图 Logo 和数据。
cases.baseline_output: A visually similar output that accidentally retains source labels or brand elements.
assertions: source logo and data literals are in source_exclusions
portable style module does not repeat source literals
generation prompt explicitly excludes source literals
content graph contains only user-provided meaning
quality report checks source leakage
cases.human_notes: Judge that similarity comes from visual grammar, not copied content or exact composition.

cases.prompt: 把刚提取的风格保存为‘马卡龙三级科研框架’。
cases.baseline_output: A renamed prompt file without the original visual reference, metadata, lifecycle or integrity evidence.
assertions: pack contains style-prompt.md and style-spec.json
pack contains a byte-preserved copy of every original reference image
pack manifest stores original filename and hash but not absolute source path
pack rights_scope is personal-local
duplicate active visual fingerprints are rejected
catalog entry is created without loading prompt bodies into catalog.json
cases.human_notes: Judge whether the saved asset can reproduce the style later without relying on the old conversation.

cases.prompt: 用‘马卡龙三级科研框架’模板把下面的新内容画成图。
cases.baseline_output: Generation uses a short named-style phrase or preview image only.
assertions: named pack resolves to its complete style prompt and style spec
original stored reference images are used as style references
preview image is not used as the default style anchor
new content still receives a fresh content graph and visual plan
final response includes the generated image and exact full prompt
cases.human_notes: Judge whether the original reference plus canonical prompt materially anchors reuse.
